Geometry_and_Silhouette: Rectangular plastic or metal case, 15-25 cm wide, 5-10 cm tall.
Display panel is recessed or flush with front face.
Colon separator between hours and minutes blinks.
Functional_Components: LED or LCD numeric display showing hours and minutes in 7-segment digit format.
Display digits are bright red, green, or blue (LED) or gray-on-black (LCD).
Buttons on top or rear for time setting and alarm.
Material_and_Context: Surface is smooth plastic with matte or glossy finish.
Power cord or battery compartment visible.
Alarm clock variants show additional display for alarm time and indicator lights.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Rectangular or square display recessed in round or square case.
Case diameter 35-45 mm, thickness 10-15 mm.
Strap width 18-22 mm with buckle or deployment clasp.
Functional_Components: Display shows hours:minutes in 7-segment digits, with date, day, or stopwatch sub-displays.
Button configuration: 2-4 pushers on case side for mode selection.
Backlight may illuminate display.
Material_and_Context: Case material is plastic, stainless steel, or titanium.
Band is rubber, silicone, metal link, or leather.
Water resistance rating indicated on case back.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Large flat-surfaced table, 120-240 cm long, 80-100 cm wide, 75 cm height.
Top is rectangular, round, or oval.
Edge profile is straight, beveled, or rounded.
Functional_Components: Leg configuration: four legs at corners, pedestal base, or trestle.
Proportions accommodate 4-12 place settings.
Surface is smooth with wood grain pattern, polished stone veining, or uniform color.
Material_and_Context: Wood (solid or veneer), glass (tempered, transparent or frosted), stone (marble, granite), or laminate.
Wood finish is stained, painted, or natural.
Glass top is transparent or frosted.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Rectangular cleaning cloth, 30x30 cm to 40x40 cm.
Edges are serged or hemmed to prevent fraying.
When crumpled, exhibits soft drape and high compressibility.
Functional_Components: Texture is looped terry weave, smooth woven, or textured microfiber.
Fabric weight is medium, becoming heavier when wet.
Surface shows characteristic weave pattern: terry loops or flat weave with visible thread grid.
Material_and_Context: Absorbent fabric (cotton, microfiber, or terry cloth).
Colors vary: solid (white, blue, yellow, green), striped, or checkered patterns.
Terry loops on one or both sides.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Box-shaped kitchen appliance, 60x60x85 cm standard.
Front-loading door opens downward.
Control panel on top edge of door or front face.
Functional_Components: Door reveals interior rack system (upper and lower baskets).
Racks are wire-grid construction with adjustable tines and cup shelves.
Control panel features buttons, digital display, and cycle indicators.
Material_and_Context: Exterior is stainless steel (brushed finish), white, or black enamel.
Interior tub is stainless steel or plastic (white or gray).
Door handle is integrated or protruding bar. Kickplate at bottom.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Circular metal rotor (disc), 25-35 cm diameter, 2-3 cm thick.
Caliper is cast metal mounted over rotor edge.
Rotor is mounted to wheel hub with visible lug bolt pattern.
Functional_Components: Rotor is ventilated (two plates with cooling fins) or solid.
Brake pads are rectangular friction material blocks pressing against rotor faces.
Hydraulic lines connect to caliper.
Material_and_Context: Surface shows machined concentric grooves or cross-drilled holes.
Surface exhibits heat discoloration (blue/brown tint) from use.
Caliper is cast aluminum or iron.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Harbor landing structure extending into water, 10-100+ meters long, 2-5 meters wide.
Surface is flat decking (wooden boards with gaps, or concrete slab).
Gangway may connect to shore.
Functional_Components: Edge features cleats (metal T-shaped fittings) for mooring lines, bollards, and ladders descending to water.
Fendering (rubber or tire bumpers) along edges.
Supported by pilings or floats.
Material_and_Context: Wood planks, concrete, or metal construction.
Surface shows weathering: wood graying, concrete staining, rust on metal fixtures.
Water level visible beneath, with tidal variation marks on pilings.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Two parallel curved runners (skis) connected by crossbars and platform.
Runner length 2-4 meters, curved upward at front (brush bow).
Overall structure is lightweight, low-profile.
Functional_Components: Platform is wooden slats or fabric bed for cargo/passenger.
Handlebar (brush bow) at front for steering.
Drag brake and snow hook at rear.
Material_and_Context: Wood variant: ash or hickory with natural finish.
Metal variant: aluminum tubing.
Construction shows lashed or bolted joints.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Hemispherical or elliptical roof structure.
Diameter varies 5-100+ meters.
Base is circular or polygonal ring.
Functional_Components: Construction shows radial ribs or geodesic triangulation pattern.
Surface may feature lantern cupola at apex, or oculus opening.
Panel seams create geometric grid pattern.
Material_and_Context: Concrete (gray, formwork texture), copper (green patina or polished bronze), glass (transparent panes with metal framing), or fabric (tensioned membrane).
Curvature is mathematically precise (spherical, parabolic, or ellipsoidal).
Smooth curved shell surface.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Rectangular floor covering, 40x60 cm to 60x90 cm.
Thickness 1-3 cm.
Edges are bound (fabric tape) or molded (rubber).
Functional_Components: Surface texture is abrasive (coir bristles), patterned (rubber diamond grid), or printed (welcome message).
Backing is non-slip rubber or bare.
Shows dirt accumulation and wear patterns at center.
Material_and_Context: Coir (coconut fiber, brown, coarse texture), rubber (black, molded pattern), synthetic (polypropylene, colored), or fabric (cotton, woven).
